# Reliable Investments Company (ricforex.com)

> Forex and gold (XAUUSD) copy trading. Our team's algorithmic system SmartStrike trades mainly gold; its trades are copied automatically to the client's own broker account (MetaTrader). The money stays in the client's account — we have no access to deposits or withdrawals. Fee: 50% of profit only, settled weekly; after a loss the fee resumes only once the account is back at its previous high. Every trade has a stop-loss. Three risk models. 14-day free demo. Clients from any country, including the USA. Sites in Russian and English.
